properties.text: Permanent disk memory structure for zero-context-loss autonomous execution

F .agents
 > rules/
  - rtk-protocol.md
  - ponytail-minimal.md
  - hard-boundaries.md
  - test-first.md
 > prompts/
  - orchestrator.template.md
  - storyteller.template.md
  - implementer.template.md
  - storyconnector.template.md
  - reviewer.template.md
 > skills/
  - .unittest/SKILL.md
  - .integrationtest/SKILL.md
  - .cleancode/SKILL.md
  - .scenariowriter/SKILL.md
  - .eventwriter/SKILL.md
  - .handoff/SKILL.md
  - .architecture/SKILL.md
 > state/
  - phase.md (Task Backlog)
  - progress.md (Current %)
  - active-session.json
Single Source of Instructions & Templates for Headless Agents

F beauty-saloon-api
 - AGENTS.md (Rules & Hard Boundaries)
 - CONTEXT.md (Domain Glossary)
 - BarberSalon.sln
 > src/
  > BarberSalon.Domain/
  > BarberSalon.Application/
  > BarberSalon.Infrastructure/
  > BarberSalon.API/
 > tests/
  > BarberSalon.Domain.Tests/
  > BarberSalon.Application.Tests/
 > docs/
  > examples/
   - SalonService-complete.md
  > architecture/
   - agents-loop-architecture.bmpr

1. XML Documentation on all public types
2. Swagger [ProducesResponseType] coverage
3. Zero MediatR / Zero CQRS / Zero Identity
4. EF Core migrations strictly in Infrastructure
5. Soft-delete only (IsActive = false)

F beauty-saloon-front-V2
 > src/
  > components/ (UI & Forms)
  > store/ (Redux Slices)
  > services/ (API & Mock Handlers)
  > types/ (Contract DTOs)
 > docs/
  - PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md

File-based Shared Memory:
- memory/phase.md: Current sprint tasks
- memory/handoff.md: Last agent output
- memory/review.md: Review verdict & notes
- memory/progress.md: Completed % board

Guarantees zero context drift across subagent sessions.
